## Outcome and requirements

<!-- State the problem and before/after behavior. Link the issue/specification and summarize the essential user-approved decisions here; reviewers cannot see the chat. List testable acceptance criteria. Keep small PRs concise. -->

## Intentional behavior and scope

<!-- Explain deliberate constraints/tradeoffs and why they are required, including accepted negative/error behavior. State non-goals. Cite the requirement/decision; do not reclassify accidental limitations or security/data-integrity defects as intentional. Use "None" when appropriate. -->

## Implementation and dependencies

<!-- Summarize how the change meets the criteria. Link dependent PRs and note compatibility/merge order for shared contracts. No unrelated redesign or version/deployment narrative for ordinary feature PRs. -->

## Verification

<!-- Map each criterion to test/manual evidence: exact commands or procedure, result, and relevant commit/environment. Distinguish local checks, CI, rendered/live checks, expected-negative results, and untested/blocked coverage. Refresh current-head CI and review evidence after pushes. -->

## Risks and open decisions

<!-- Describe concrete regression/operational risks and unresolved requirement questions, or "None". For release/auto-deploy changes, identify the authorized target, effects, and recovery evidence. Do not expose credentials or sensitive test data. -->

## Review dispositions

<!-- On review iterations, record any disputed/accepted finding, its requirement/evidence, and agreed disposition. Resolve justified threads; do not hide genuine defects or reopen unchanged decisions without new evidence. Reviewers: report concrete requirement/invariant violations separately from optional enhancements and questions. -->
